notes:
The app stores property records and attachments on the device.
On first launch, open Properties, add a building and its first room, then use Actions to add a repair, renewal, or inspection.
All features are available without signing in.
The camera is optional.
Files and the system photo picker are available when the camera is unavailable.
Local notifications are optional and only requested when a reminder is enabled.
The app has no payments, purchases, advertising, analytics, or data collection service.
